description: This file is a Smarty plugin defining the 'sugar_field' function used in templates to retrieve the appropriate Smarty output for a given SugarCRM field, based on parameters such as vardef, displayType, and others. It requires the SugarFieldHandler class and interacts with SugarCRM's display system.

classes.name: SugarFieldHandler
classes.description: Class responsible for handling and rendering SugarCRM fields within Smarty templates.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_field
methods.description: Main plugin function that checks parameters, initializes the SugarFieldHandler, configures display parameters, and returns the Smarty output for a SugarCRM field.
